single_reference.note: single drive: only the lump phi_d/zeta is identifiable (confounded)

multi_reference.note: D drives: the D-1 drive-participation RATIOS phi_di/phi_dj become identifiable (gauge-invariant, zeta-free); zeta separated up to ONE residual per-mode gauge (overall phi_d<->zeta scale), resolved only by anchoring phi_d (FEM) or the half-power bandwidth.

interpretation: STIFFNESS: multi-reference excites a larger union of modes than +X alone → the θ Fisher information gains rows; n_dirs_above_floor single→multi quantifies the gain (the textbook multi-reference benefit for modal identification). AMPLITUDE: multi-reference makes the D-1 drive-participation ratios identifiable (breaking the φ_d-vs-φ_s-vs-ζ lump into a separable drive ratio), but a single per-mode gauge (overall φ_d↔ζ scale) remains — so it constrains the DRIVE side, not a held-out SENSOR's φ_s.
